title: 静态 vs 连续批处理：吞吐与加速比
expected_output:
静态批处理总步数: 8
连续批处理总步数(简化): 5
加速比: 1.60x
code:
REQ_LAT = 4
BATCH = 4
static_steps = (8 // BATCH) * REQ_LAT
continuous_steps = REQ_LAT + (8 // BATCH) - 1
print("静态批处理总步数:", static_steps)
print("连续批处理总步数(简化):", continuous_steps)
print("加速比:", f"{static_steps/continuous_steps:.2f}x")
